gloss: all over the house; the whole family

definitions.gloss: all over the house; the whole house
the whole family; everyone in the house
definitions.explanation: Everyone who lives in the house.

notes:
〜{中|じゅう} means "throughout": {家中|いえじゅう} "all over the house," like ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧ "all day" and ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧ "all over the world."

- {家中|いえじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search the whole house
- {家中|いえじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: to echo through the house
- {家中|いえじゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: as a whole family

WATCH OUT:
Read ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ちゅう, {家中|かちゅう} is a historical word for the retainers of a feudal lord; in modern speech the word is いえじゅう.
